pr_body:
Change TaskCommand._get_ti to return either TaskInstance or TaskInstancePydantic, making sure it calls the InternalAPI in dbless mode.

Some CLI commands, despite calling TaskCommand._get_ti still assume access to database.

closes: #29320
related: #29320
pr_comments: There are some circular dependency issues
BTW. Fix to failing "Skip Build" in https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/35503
Finally I made the tests green. There were some changes required. PTAL.

issue_context.title: AIP-44 Migrate TaskCommand._get_ti to Internal API

review_comments: This is a breaking change; we cannot remove an argument from a public method. Could you deprecate it instead, or even keep it and support both params?

Unless I am mistaken this is not breaking change. I think we can change signature of public methods as long as they are not [public interface](https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/stable/public-airflow-interface.html). I dont expect users to use this method in their DAGs so I think it is safe to modify it. Not being able to modify any public method would restraint very much the development in Airflow IMHO
